name: sky-dull-v1
description: DIAGNOSTIC, 2026-08-20, RE-CUT FOR v31 (02/09/2026). The companion to sky-tax-v1 and the harder of the two reads. Same question - is the Aerodrome eating the Vegetable suit? - asked from the reward side instead of the price side: the balloon rewards drop from 4 to 1, so a flight is worth taking only when the seat has nothing better. This is NOT a design proposal; it is the counterfactual that says how much of Vegetable's deficit is the sky's pull. Base is the shipped game. READ THE SAME FOUR LINES as sky-tax-v1: Vegetable's win rate, its island deliveries, balloon moves per game, the Vegetable seat's share of them. CONFOUND, and it is bigger here than in the price arm: V4, V8, V16, V17 and V19 are five of Vegetable's eighteen deck cards and every one of them points at this module, so a win rate that does NOT move is the interesting result - it would mean the sky is neither helping nor hurting and five cards are pointing at nothing. ⚠️ THE ARM IS NOW THREE BALLOONS, NOT FOUR. v31 turned the magenta balloon from 'Gain GBP 4' into 'Harvest any building, even if it is not full', which is a permission and carries no amount, so it cannot be dulled at all and stays at full strength under this overlay. Whatever the arm measures is therefore an UNDER-estimate of the sky's pull, and if the result is close to the noise floor the honest reading is that this overlay can no longer answer the question on its own. ⚠️ Every number quoted in the old version of this description was measured before v31 against reference-v9, which priced coins; none of them is comparable and they have been removed rather than left to mislead.
